title: Displacement from nowhere
prompt: It is 10:32 ET. Read the chart and decide.

intro.beginner: The move looks strong. Ask what price did to the nearby highs and lows before it, and whether anything was taken.

whyNot.label: buying the retrace into the gap
whyNot.why: The gap is clean, the break of structure is real, and nothing was swept before it. Displacement without a reason is just a move: the model needs liquidity taken first to explain why price turned there.

reference.summary: A clean displacement, a break of the last 5m high and a gap, from the middle of a range, with no liquidity taken beforehand. It has the shape of a setup without the thing that makes one. It fails.

bias.why: The Daily and 4H are ranging; this move from the middle of the range doesn't change that.

decision.why: A pattern with no liquidity taken before it isn't the setup. Stand aside, or wait for a sweep of something real.

take.why: The shape is there and the cause isn't.

draw.why: No clear draw: nothing has been taken and nothing is being targeted.

next_objective.why: Price was drawn to the previous day low (20,252.75). The question is where price was likely to be pulled, not what the next candle would do. A previous-day extreme is also a pool of buy-side or sell-side liquidity, so that answer is right on the side, if less exact.

annotations.label: 5m bullish FVG
annotations.why: A clean gap from a clean displacement, and a move from nowhere. Real as a pattern, and nothing explains it.
annotations.whyNot: Without taken liquidity before it, a displacement is just momentum. It needs a reason to turn.

annotations.label: The 5m high it broke 20,320.5
annotations.why: Broken by body close, and a minor swing in the middle of a range: breaking it says little.

annotations.label: Overnight low 20,246.25
annotations.why: The pool a valid long would have swept first. Untouched.

confluences.label: No liquidity was taken before the move
The move started in the middle of a range
A break of the last 5m high
confluences.why: A minor swing in a range.

confluences.label: A clean FVG to enter from
confluences.why: A good entry model for a move with no cause.

lookFor: Look left for what was taken before the move. If the answer is nothing, so is the setup.
A displacement tells you who was in control for a few minutes. A sweep tells you why.
